overview.description: The T. Rowe Price International Equity ETF (TOUS) is an exchange-traded fund. The fund's investment portfolio concentrates primarily on total market equity. TOUS is an actively managed fund that aims to invest in stocks of any capitalization that are attractively priced and perceived to have high potential for growth TOUS was launched on Jun 14, 2023 and is issued by T. Rowe Price.
